## ⛔ Correction — the LINE NUMBERS in this card's body are wrong. The substance holds.

`domain:devx` PM seat, session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, 2026-09-13T03:57Z. Self-correction, ⛔ nobody reported this.

### What is wrong

The card body cites `scanSource` at `:198`, `blank` at `:416`, `stripComments` at `:445`, `maskComments` at `:461`. **All four are wrong.** The true lines:

| export | cited | **actual** |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `scanSource` | `:198` | **`:222`** |
| `blank` | `:416` | **`:440`** |
| `stripComments` | `:445` | **`:469`** |
| `maskComments` | `:461` | **`:485`** |

### Where they came from — and why this is not simple drift

I read those four line numbers out of the **working tree** of the shared checkout at `/home/user/objectui`, which is **648 commits behind `origin/main`** (its HEAD is `28cfff491a`, 2026-09-06). Everything else in the card — the counts, the importer lists, the control — I read with `git grep`/`git show` against the **ref**, and those are correct.

⚠️ **This is not a case of the file moving under the citation.** Proven:

```
scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs blob
  @ c64975e9f4 (the base I filed against)  e9e8f43a6374b049b3be3095fa6d93063c8d16e3
  @ origin/main b2bb8134d3 (now)           e9e8f43a6374b049b3be3095fa6d93063c8d16e3   ← identical
  @ the stale working tree                 08c990d1753e9e35dec21be28c68445c1211bd7f   ← different file
```

⇒ The file is **byte-identical** at the base I filed against and at `origin/main`; it has not changed at all. The cited numbers were **never** correct at any base — they describe a 648-commit-old copy of the file. ⛔ A reader following them would land ~24 lines short, inside unrelated code, and would reasonably conclude the card was fabricated.

### ⭐ What is NOT wrong — re-verified at `origin/main` just now

The finding itself stands, unchanged:

| export | docblock | `@param` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `scanSource` `:222` | yes | ✅ `@param {string} source` |
| `blank` `:440` | **none at all** | ❌ |
| `stripComments` `:469` | yes (prose only) | ❌ |
| `maskComments` `:485` | yes (prose only) | ❌ |

And the counts, re-run against the base this card was filed on — **exactly as filed**: `maskComments` 4 importers / 9 call sites, `blank` 3 / 3, `stripComments` 0 / 0 ⇒ **12 unchecked call sites across 6 files**. `tsconfig.scripts.json:109` `"allowJs": true` is also correct as cited.

⚠️ Those counts have since **moved** for an ordinary reason: PR objectui#9332 landed and added importers, so on today's `origin/main` it reads 6 importers / 11 call sites. ⛔ That is drift, not error — the card's numbers were right for the base it named.

### ⭐ The lesson, recorded against this seat

⇒ **A mixed-source read is worse than a consistently stale one.** Ref-based counts next to working-tree line numbers produce a card whose every *number* is right and whose every *pointer* is wrong — which is harder to catch than a card that is uniformly wrong, because the substance keeps checking out.

⇒ This repo runs a `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` gate, so line citations are load-bearing here, not decoration. **Cite from the ref you measured on, or do not cite a line.**

⚠️ Credit where due: this was caught because the objectui#9205 dev flagged the shared checkout's staleness in its report as a note for the seat. It was measuring something else entirely.

⚠️ ⭐ **卡面与评论里的每个行号、每个计数都要现测**,并印出你测的 ref。主检出树落后 `origin/main` 数百个提交;一律 `git show <ref>:<path>`。⛔ 一个数字都不许抄。
⚠️ **每个计数都要用文字点名它数的是什么人口。**
⚠️ 任何「某串已消失」的腿用 code-only reader `grep -vE '^\s*(\*|//|/\*)'`;⭐ 若交付面**本身就是注释或字符串**,那条腿要**故意读注释**并写明 —— 今天有一位 dev 的 ablation 就是因为 naive grep 把**散文**读成代码而作废重跑。
⚠️ 每条零读数都要一条**方向已知、同一轮必须命中**的对照。
⚠️ 两侧相等的腿必须**印出命中行**或带**非空护栏**(空串 sha256 = `e3b0c44298fc1c14`)。本席今天有**七**条腿栽在这上面,dev 零条。
⚠️ 用 `sed` 取一段声明时**range 必须终止**(例:`const X = {…\n};`)—— 未终止的 range 不是读错数字,是**读了另一个人口**。
